_rule: External research says what the wider ecosystem does. It never overrides own-account analytics; disagreements are recorded.

findings.claim: In a Feb 2026 survey of 1,500 US teens, questions about livelihood, the future, truth, belonging and purpose carried the most urgency; whether God loves them (57%) and whether God is real (56%) ranked lowest but are still carried by more than half.
findings.source: Barna Group, The Big Questions on Teens' Minds Today (June 2026)

findings.claim: Young adults often do not feel they can be themselves or ask honest questions in religious gatherings.
findings.source: Christian Standard summarising Springtide Research Institute (May 2026)

findings.claim: Sharad Navratri runs 11 to 19 Oct 2026 and Dussehra is 20 Oct 2026.
Telangana schools are closed 10 to 22 Oct 2026 and Andhra Pradesh schools 10 to 21 Oct 2026 for Dussehra holidays.
For Reels, DM sends are described as the most heavily weighted distribution signal; watch time stays critical.
findings.source: Buffer, How the Instagram Algorithm Works (Sep 2026); Hootsuite (2026)

findings.claim: Same-day posts make up more than 30% of recommended Reels; Reels under 90 seconds are pushed to non-followers.

opportunities.opportunity: Festival-holiday loneliness: students and workers left behind in hostels or rented rooms while others travel home (11 to 22 Oct). Written as one moment, no festival named.
'Is God real?' as a lived moment (a friend asks and you have no answer), not an apologetics lecture.
Belonging and home-life pressure (parents fighting, people-pleasing) as DM-sendable moments a viewer would forward to one person.
Keep runtime 70 to 80s, under the 90s non-follower push line.

disagreements_with_account_data.note: Own report for week 2026-09-28 says one_pushback beat full_arc on Instagram reach (n=3 vs 13). Too small to act on; full arc held steady per the 'two variables under test' rule.
